typography.primary_font_usage: Headlines, Page Titles, Dashboard Summary Numbers (H1, H2, H3)
typography.secondary_font_usage: Body text, paragraphs, general UI labels, navigation
typography.mono_font_usage: IP Addresses, server metrics (CPU %, RAM %), logs, code blocks, port numbers, dates
rules: H1 size max text-4xl on desktop, tight tracking (tracking-tight).
Overlines and table headers must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
No Inter or generic fonts for headings.
No full-screen gradients. Keep it completely flat and solid.
Never use pure black #000000; stick to #050505.
Status colors must be highly vibrant (electric) to stand out against the deep dark background.

layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6 for containers. Inner elements tight gap-2 or gap-4.
rules: Dashboard summary uses 4-col layout on desktop (Summary metrics).
Server list uses dense data tables or wide 1-col bento rows.
No soft rounded corners larger than 8px (rounded-md). Prefer crisp edges.
Use 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)': container border-collapse, items with border-r border-b using border-grid color.

components.surfaces: Flat variant. Background #111111, 1px solid border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), NO drop shadow.
components.buttons: Sharp rectangles or max 4px radius. High contrast: Primary buttons white bg, black text. Secondary buttons #111111 bg with white border.
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border, background #050505. On focus: border changes to white/30.
components.charts: Recharts with mono-font axis labels and thin neon lines (#00FF66 or #FF3366). No fill gradients, just strict line charts.
components.tags_badges: Used for server status. Solid neon dot + mono text. Background transparent. Sharp corners.
components.tables: Dense. Padding py-2 px-3. Mono-font for numerical data columns. Hover state highlights entire row background to #161616.

motion.hover_states: Border color brighten. Subtle bg color shift.
motion.transitions: Instant or 150ms ease-out. No slow swooping animations. It must feel like a fast terminal. Use purely for state changes.
motion.loading: Use monospace ASCII loaders or simple sharp spinners. No generic pulse circles.

icons_and_media.icon_style: Sharp, thin stroke (1.5px), monochrome unless indicating specific status (red for error).

auth_background.description: Abstract cyber network lines for the login screen background (must use with deep black overlay).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Dimmed text must be readable.
accessibility.focus: Visible 1px solid white ring on all interactive elements via focus-visible.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium, dark-mode-first server/infrastructure dashboard.
CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js/.jsx files, not .tsx. Do not output TypeScript.
Avoid generic 'SaaS dashboard' looks. Embrace a command-center, technical aesthetic (Grid Borders, Monospace data, Sharp edges).
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main grid layouts, rely on Shadcn UI (customized heavily for flat/dark mode) for Select, Dialog, Tables.
DO NOT use clear/transparent backgrounds for headers or sticky elements; use solid #050505.
Data displays (IPs, uptime %, ports, expiry dates) MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Use Recharts for performance metrics (CPU, RAM). Keep the lines thin and vibrant against dark backgrounds.
Implement data-testid on every button, link, and form input.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Never center-align paragraphs or dense metric tables.
Avoid generic AI emojis in the UI.
Create depth through layering borders and subtle background shades, not drop shadows.
Apply 'data-testid' to all key interactive elements for testability.
